Două modele de vedere artificială ruleaz: Two computer-vision models run in your browser with transformers.js, using WebGPU where available and WebAssembly elsewhere. You download them once, then they stay cached.
La fiecare 0,8 s, un cadru din cameră sa: Every 0.8 s, a frame from the camera or your photo.
OWL-ViT localizează fructul și separă mâ: OWL-ViT finds the fruit and tells it apart from hands, faces and people.

Până la trei fructe din același cadru pr: Up to three fruits in the same frame each get their own label, with names in Romanian and English and their vitamins.
Modele: Xenova/owlvit-base-patch32 · Xen: Models: Xenova/owlvit-base-patch32 · Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32 · downloaded once, then started from browser storage
Odată cu fiecare cadru, FruitAI măsoară: With every frame, FruitAI measures light, sharpness, motion and distance to the fruit. It uses these signals to guide you, adjust the label contrast and avoid running the models for nothing. The values below are measured right now from your camera.
Luminozitatea medie a cadrului. În lumin: The average brightness of the frame. In low light you get a tip, and in a very bright frame the label becomes more opaque.
Cât detaliu are imaginea. O fotografie m: How much detail the image has. A blurry or out-of-focus photo is flagged before you get a wrong result.
Diferența dintre cadre. Când scena nu se: The difference between frames. When the scene doesn't change, the result is kept without a new analysis to save battery.
Cât din cadru ocupă fructul detectat. Te: How much of the frame the detected fruit fills. It tells you to move closer or further away for a good identification.
Modul din cameră merge în orice browser: Camera mode works in any modern browser with a camera. Spatial mode uses WebXR and only appears on devices that support it. The status below is checked on your device.
Fiecare fruct detectat e încadrat, iar e: Every detected fruit is framed and its label with names and vitamins sticks to it, with the vitamins floating around. Tap the label to open the card, go full screen and save a capture.
Telefonul găsește masa sau podeaua, iar: Your phone finds the table or the floor and you place the 3D fruit there. Spin it, zoom it, move it and walk around it. Tap the orbiting vitamins to find out what they do. Works on Android phones with Chrome and ARCore.
